card.title: Delete this server's data
card.intro: Only you, the server owner, see this. Mewvo keeps this server's data after the bot is removed, until you ask for it to be deleted.

page.title: Delete this server's data
page.intro: Everything Mewvo stores for {name} is listed below, with the number of records of each kind. Only the server owner can ask for it to be deleted.
page.introRemoved: Mewvo is no longer in {name}. Its data is kept until you, the owner, ask for it to be deleted.
page.removeBot: And remove Mewvo from this server

kind.cases: Moderation cases (notes, evidence, edit history, warn ladder)
kind.moderation: Watchlist, no-contact orders, temporary roles, staff records, modmail links
kind.levels: Levels, birthdays, AFK and member records
kind.automod: Automod rules, raid incidents and timelines
kind.community: Tags, suggestions, starboard, giveaways, scheduled messages, role rules, feeds
kind.oauthLinks: Member backup links (who verified here with Discord)
kind.misc: Error reports, and reminders set here (they keep going by DM)

note.record: Members' "My record" on the website lists cases from every server: this server's cases disappear from there too.
note.active: Bans and mutes that are still active are not lifted in Discord, and temporary ones no longer end on their own. Lift them first if needed.
note.untouched: Not deleted: members' own Mewvo accounts and logins, their data in other servers, and other servers' cases.
note.grace: The deletion runs {days} days after you confirm. Until then you can cancel it here or on the dashboard.
note.empty: Mewvo stores nothing for this server right now.

status.scheduled: This server's data will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can cancel it.
status.leave: Mewvo will then leave the server.
status.running: The deletion is running now and can no longer be cancelled.
status.done: Mewvo deleted this server's data on {date}.
status.retry: The last attempt did not finish; it is tried again within a day.

flash.scheduled: Deletion scheduled for {date}. You can cancel it until then.
flash.already: A deletion is already scheduled for {date}.
flash.cancelled: The deletion was cancelled. Nothing was deleted.
flash.notScheduled: There was no scheduled deletion to cancel.
flash.running: The deletion is already running and can no longer be cancelled.

errors.title: Not possible
errors.notOwner: Only the owner of this server can do this.
errors.home: Mewvo's own servers cannot be deleted this way.
errors.unknown: Discord did not confirm who owns this server right now, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

verify.title: Confirm that you own this server
verify.text: Mewvo checks with Discord that you still own {name}. This takes you to Discord and straight back.

picker.label: Delete the data Mewvo stored for {name}
